data.one_liner: Wraps an object in a separate isolate to run its methods off the main isolate.
data.what_it_does: Creates a dedicated isolate for a given object and forwards method calls to it via closures. Returns the result asynchronously and can shut down the isolate with close().
use_when: Heavy synchronous work blocks the UI and you need a simple background executor for a single object
You want a dependency‑free way to keep timers or animations alive while the main isolate is busy
avoid_when: You need multiple isolates or complex inter‑isolate communication
You require UI widgets or platform channel integration
You need code‑generation or advanced state‑management features
weaknesses: One isolate per object adds startup overhead
No built‑in error handling beyond failing in‑flight calls
